_comment: The Insights index. Written by the admin panel at /admin/blog/. Entries with `legacy: true` are the four hand-written HTML articles in public/ that predate this system — they keep their own URLs and their own markup, and the panel will not edit them. Everything else is a markdown file in src/content/articles/<slug>.md and is served at /insights/<slug>/. Newest first is the display order; `date` decides it, not position in this file.
